parameters.text:
=You are an AI customer support triage assistant.

Analyze the following customer message:

Customer Name:
{{ $json.customer_name }}

Customer Email:
{{ $json.customer_email }}

Customer Message:
{{ $json.message }}

Classify the message according to the following rules:

category:
- billing
- technical
- account
- general
- other

priority:
- low
- medium
- high

Use "high" for urgent issues, serious technical problems, incorrect charges, account access problems, security concerns, or messages explicitly requesting urgent assistance.

sentiment:
- positive
- neutral
- frustrated
- negative

department:
- Billing
- Technical Support
- Account Support
- Customer Service
- Other

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:

{
  "category": "billing",
  "priority": "high",
  "sentiment": "frustrated",
  "department": "Billing",
  "summary": "Short summary of the customer issue.",
  "suggested_response": "Professional response to the customer."
}

parameters.subject: =We Received Your Support Request – {{ $json.ticket_id }}
parameters.message: =Hello {{ $json.customer_name }},  Thank you for contacting our support team. We have received your request and created ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }}.  Issue Summary: {{ $json.summary }}  Your request has been assigned to the {{ $json.department }} team.  {{ $json.suggested_response }}  Priority: {{ $json.priority }}  Best regards, Customer Support Team

parameters.subject: =URGENT: {{ $json.ticket_id }} Requires Immediate Attention
parameters.message: =An urgent customer support ticket requires immediate attention.  Ticket ID: {{ $json.ticket_id }} Customer: {{ $json.customer_name }} Email: {{ $json.customer_email }}  Category: {{ $json.category }} Priority: {{ $json.priority }} Sentiment: {{ $json.sentiment }} Department: {{ $json.department }}  Customer Message: {{ $json.customer_message }}  Summary: {{ $json.summary }}  Suggested Response: {{ $json.suggested_response }}  Please review and take appropriate action.
